title: ContextWell Lab
summary: An independent research and innovation initiative exploring human-centred AI, well-being and human capability — translating research into frameworks, systems and real-world applications.
overview: ContextWell Lab is an independent research initiative focused on human-centred AI and well-being — translating the Spectrum of Contextual Well-being into applied AI systems and concrete clinical outcomes.
what: Research, system design and prototyping around agency-preserving AI in high-pressure environments, starting with medical education.
role: Founder and director — setting research direction, leading system development, and executing within a lean structure.

title: ISLA Society
summary: A university society I founded at the University of Galway, created to support international scholars and students through community building, connection and collaborative opportunities.
overview: ISLA Society is a university society I founded at the University of Galway to support international scholars and students through community building, connection and collaborative opportunities. The society grew into a community reaching 500+ people, creating opportunities for international students and scholars to connect, share experiences and build a stronger academic community.
what: Institutional funding applications, digital strategy, and community initiatives for international scholars.
role: Founder — built a strategic team, secured institutional funding, and led cross-functional work in digital strategy.
